title: Moves
description: Every move the app teaches. Grouped by style in the file and shown in this order.

id.description: Stable short id. People's progress and practice logs refer to it, so never change or reuse one that has shipped.

style.description: Id of the style in data/styles.json this move belongs to.

difficulty.description: 1 (first night out), 2 (needs a little practice) or 3 (takes a few sessions).

buildsOn.description: Move ids worth being comfortable with first. [] for a starting point.

focus.description: Which part of the body (or skill) the move mostly trains.

counts.description: How the move fits the beat, e.g. '1 step · 2 touch'.

summary.description: One or two sentences describing the move.

steps.description: Short, ordered cues for doing the move.

tips.description: Practice tips and ways to vary it.

why.description: Optional: why this move is worth learning, when it isn't obvious.

video.description: Optional link to a video that shows the move.
